hypothesis: Among runs without a strict record improvement during the last 1000 new evaluations, some retained record masks have a better feasible radius-two neighbor.

inputs.bank: 30 masks: first all zero, other 29 independent Bernoulli(1/2) bits; do not deduplicate
inputs.operator_rng: unchanged make_rngs(class_code, instance_index, search_seed); preparation has a separate generator

diagnosis.stagnation: q minus latest strict feasible record improvement q; initialization is q=0
diagnosis.record_tie: retain first mask attaining each strictly improved record
diagnosis.checkpoint_population: latest fully committed population at q, with evaluated pending offspring listed separately
diagnosis.certificate_scope: retained record mask only, not the whole population or the whole neutral component
diagnosis.neighborhood: all feasible Hamming distance 1 and 2 neighbors; also record infeasible neighbors
diagnosis.certificate_cache: post-search only, keyed by immutable instance identity and mask
diagnosis.optimum_source: existing independently confirmed exact values; no new DP executions
diversity: mean pairwise Hamming distance over unordered position pairs; duplicates included
diagnosis.certificate_verification: independent original-item integer recomputation of center and every neighbor

analysis.family_weighting: ratio of equal-family-weighted numerator and denominator counts; not mean of within-family conditional proportions
figures: terminal stagnation age by certified state
fixed example record and both population diversity measures

resource_policy.technical_authorization: user explicitly approved 60 cumulative runner minutes on 2026-10-20

evidence.raw: all evaluated masks and operators, generation population references and RNG states, checkpoints, per-unique-mask complete neighbor certificates
evidence.compact: run identities, checkpoint diagnostics, certificate hashes, completeness, time and byte accounting, provenance and transport ledgers
evidence.incomplete_cases: retain with explicit status; no successful replacement

sources.title: Stagnation Detection in Highly Multimodal Fitness Landscapes
sources.role: stagnation, nearest improving distance and limits of randomized neighborhood exploration; not a reproduction of SD-RLS

sources.title: Local Optima Networks of NK Landscapes with Neutrality
sources.role: locality depends on neighborhood; equal neighbor does not certify a closed neutral component
